verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a public Python API package for scripts that control and extend iTerm2, plus a documented AppleScript interface. Community users independently praise the Python API as letting them 'touch pretty much everything.' Missing for 10: no machine-readable spec or agent-oriented docs (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes return 404), and the evidence does not show the depth of the API reference itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: iTerm2 offers a Python package which makes it easy to write Python scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior.
Python Scripting API - Full automation and customization via Python. Create custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features.
iTerm2 has sophisticated AppleScript support allowing one to write stand-alone scripts to launch the application and open multiple sessions with profiles into either new tabs or new windows.
Python scripting API: basically AppleScript for iTerm except it lets you touch pretty much everything and it's not soul-crushing to write.
